families.opacity: State-layer opacities: the on-colour of a container, painted over it at this strength.
families.radius: Material Design's corner scale, from square to fully round.
families.shadow: Two-layer key and ambient shadows, one per elevation level. Level 0 has none.
families.sizing: Container heights from the Material Design spec pages. A component takes the step its spec names.
families.spacing: A 4px grid. Stack's `gap` takes the same step names.

palettes.negative: Negative custom palette, for amounts the reader owes; kept apart from error
palettes.neutral: Neutral tonal palette: surfaces, backgrounds and primary text
palettes.neutralVariant: Neutral variant tonal palette: borders and muted text, tinted toward the brand hue
palettes.positive: Positive custom palette, for amounts owed to the reader
palettes.secondary: Secondary tonal palette, a muted relative of primary
palettes.tertiary: Tertiary tonal palette, roughly complementary to primary

bodyLarge.sample: Supporting line that runs long enough to wrap.

bodyMedium.sample: Supporting line that runs long enough to wrap.

bodySmall.sample: Supporting line that runs long enough to wrap.

displayLarge.usage: The largest text on a screen: a short hero number or statement.

displayMedium.usage: The largest text on a screen: a short hero number or statement.

displaySmall.usage: The largest text on a screen: a short hero number or statement.

labelLarge.usage: Text inside controls: buttons, chips, tabs, field labels, badges.

labelMedium.usage: Text inside controls: buttons, chips, tabs, field labels, badges.

labelSmall.usage: Text inside controls: buttons, chips, tabs, field labels, badges.

titleLarge.usage: Card, dialog and list headings; `titleMedium` and `titleSmall` set controls' own titles.

titleMedium.usage: Card, dialog and list headings; `titleMedium` and `titleSmall` set controls' own titles.

titleSmall.usage: Card, dialog and list headings; `titleMedium` and `titleSmall` set controls' own titles.

tokens.kui-color-background: The page behind every surface, from the older role set; the same tone as `kui-color-surface`, which components use instead.
tokens.kui-color-error: Validation errors: an invalid field's outline, its supporting text and the error badge.
tokens.kui-color-error-container: A quieter error fill for a design's own error banner. No component draws it.
tokens.kui-color-inverse-primary: Primary actions on `kui-color-inverse-surface`, such as a snackbar's action.
tokens.kui-color-inverse-surface: Surfaces that contrast with the page: snackbars, plain tooltips, the slider's value label.
tokens.kui-color-negative: Money the reader owes, kept apart from validation errors: a negative `Currency`, `Text` tone `negative`, a negative `Tag`. Text on `kui-color-surface`.
tokens.kui-color-negative-container: A quieter negative fill: a negative `Tag`, a negative avatar mark.
tokens.kui-color-on-surface: Body text, headings and icons on every surface and surface container.
tokens.kui-color-on-surface-variant: Secondary text, supporting lines, placeholder text and inactive icons, on every surface and surface container.
tokens.kui-color-outline: Borders on interactive controls: an outlined field, an outlined button, a checkbox's box.
tokens.kui-color-outline-variant: Dividers and decorative borders: `Separator`, an outlined card, table rules, tab rules; never alone on a control.
tokens.kui-color-positive: Money owed to the reader and other good outcomes: a positive `Currency`, `Text` tone `positive`, a positive `Tag`. Text on `kui-color-surface`.
tokens.kui-color-positive-container: A quieter positive fill: a positive `Tag`, a positive avatar mark.
tokens.kui-color-primary: High-emphasis fills: filled buttons, the active indicator, focus rings, a selected control. Text in `kui-color-on-primary` sits on it.
tokens.kui-color-primary-container: Prominent tonal fills quieter than primary: a primary FAB, a selected switch handle, a selected table row, the drop zone while a file is over it.
tokens.kui-color-primary-fixed: A primary container that keeps one tone in both themes. Defined for themes; no component draws it.
tokens.kui-color-primary-fixed-dim: A deeper fixed primary fill, the same in both themes. Defined for themes; no component draws it.
tokens.kui-color-scrim: The dark layer behind a modal dialog, sheet or picker, applied with an opacity.
tokens.kui-color-secondary: Less prominent accents than primary: secondary FABs, icon buttons and the navigation's selected icon.
tokens.kui-color-secondary-container: Tonal buttons, the navigation active indicator, a selected chip or segmented button, the progress track.
tokens.kui-color-secondary-fixed: A secondary container that keeps one tone in both themes. Defined for themes; no component draws it.
tokens.kui-color-secondary-fixed-dim: A deeper fixed secondary fill, the same in both themes. Defined for themes; no component draws it.
tokens.kui-color-surface: The default canvas: page backgrounds, outlined cards, app bars at rest. Paint a design's root with it.
tokens.kui-color-surface-bright: The brightest surface, for content that comes forward. Defined for themes; no component draws it.
tokens.kui-color-surface-container: The default container: the navigation bar, a scrolled app bar, toolbars, overlays.
tokens.kui-color-surface-container-high: High-emphasis containers: dialogs, the date and time pickers, the search bar and search view.
tokens.kui-color-surface-container-highest: The most prominent container: filled fields, filled cards, the switch track, a neutral `Tag`.
tokens.kui-color-surface-container-low: Low-emphasis containers: elevated cards and buttons, menus, select and combo box lists, sheets.
tokens.kui-color-surface-container-lowest: The lowest container: the light squares of the chequer behind a transparent colour swatch.
tokens.kui-color-surface-dim: The dimmest surface, for content that sits back. Defined for themes; no component draws it.
tokens.kui-color-surface-tint: The primary tint some surfaces blend in for elevation. Defined for themes; no component draws it.
tokens.kui-color-surface-variant: A quieter surface from the older role set, used by the calendar's range fill; prefer a surface container.
tokens.kui-color-tertiary: Contrasting accents that balance primary and secondary: the tertiary FAB.
tokens.kui-color-tertiary-container: Tonal fills for a contrasting accent: a tertiary FAB, a tertiary avatar mark.
tokens.kui-color-tertiary-fixed: A tertiary container that keeps one tone in both themes. Defined for themes; no component draws it.
tokens.kui-color-tertiary-fixed-dim: A deeper fixed tertiary fill, the same in both themes. Defined for themes; no component draws it.
tokens.kui-radius-circle: A circle on a square box: radio buttons, avatar marks, the loading indicator, slider handles.
tokens.kui-radius-lg: Large shape: the FAB, the calendar and date pickers, a sheet's corners, a square button at `lg`.
tokens.kui-radius-md: Medium shape: cards, the drop zone, popovers and other overlays, a square button at the smaller sizes.
tokens.kui-radius-none: Square corners: a full-screen dialog, a sheet edge that meets the window, a segmented button's inner seams.
tokens.kui-radius-pill: Fully rounded ends: buttons at rest, badges, the search bar, the navigation indicator, switches.
tokens.kui-radius-sm: Small shape: chips, tags, the copy field, colour areas and sliders, the time picker's fields.
tokens.kui-radius-xl: Extra-large shape: dialogs, sheets, the search view, carousel items, the time picker, the largest buttons and FAB.
tokens.kui-radius-xs: Extra-small shape: fields, menus, selects, snackbars, plain tooltips, keycaps.
tokens.kui-shadow-elevation1: Level 1: elevated cards, buttons and chips at rest; a modal sheet. Theme-invariant black; in dark mode elevation shows through the surface-container tones.
tokens.kui-shadow-elevation2: Level 2: menus, popovers and pickers; a hovered elevated card or button. Theme-invariant black; in dark mode elevation shows through the surface-container tones.
tokens.kui-shadow-elevation3: Level 3: dialogs, the FAB, the snackbar, the search view. Theme-invariant black; in dark mode elevation shows through the surface-container tones.
tokens.kui-shadow-elevation4: Level 4: a hovered FAB, a dragged row. Theme-invariant black; in dark mode elevation shows through the surface-container tones.
tokens.kui-shadow-elevation5: Level 5: the highest lift; no component draws it. Theme-invariant black; in dark mode elevation shows through the surface-container tones.
tokens.kui-sizing-control-lg: The large control height: large buttons, the FAB, the search bar.
tokens.kui-sizing-control-md: The medium control height: medium buttons, tabs, the snackbar's single line.
tokens.kui-sizing-control-sm: The small control height: the default button and icon button, a segmented button.
tokens.kui-sizing-control-xl: The extra-large control height: XL buttons and the large FAB.
tokens.kui-sizing-control-xs: The extra-small control height: XS buttons and icon buttons, chips, the number field's steppers.
tokens.kui-sizing-control-xxl: The largest control height: XXL buttons and icon buttons.
tokens.kui-sizing-row-sm: One-line list rows and table rows.
tokens.kui-sizing-row-xs: Menu items and the shortest list row.
tokens.kui-spacing-lg: The default padding: card and field insets, the page gutter on compact windows.
tokens.kui-spacing-md: Padding inside compact containers and gaps between list content.
tokens.kui-spacing-sm: Gaps between related controls: buttons in a row, chips in a group.
tokens.kui-spacing-xl: Padding in dialogs and between sections of a card.
tokens.kui-spacing-xs: Tight gaps inside a control: icon to label in a chip.
tokens.kui-spacing-xxs: Hairline gaps: a badge's offset, the space between a label and its count.
tokens.kui-spacing-xxxl: The widest gap: between unrelated page regions.
tokens.kui-state-layer-opacity-disabled-contain: A disabled control's container: `kui-color-on-surface` at this opacity.
tokens.kui-state-layer-opacity-disabled-content: A disabled control's label and icon: `kui-color-on-surface` at this opacity.
tokens.kui-state-layer-opacity-dragged: The on-colour layered over an item while dragged.
tokens.kui-state-layer-opacity-focus: The on-colour layered over a container while focused by keyboard.
tokens.kui-state-layer-opacity-hover: The on-colour layered over a container while hovered.
tokens.kui-state-layer-opacity-pressed: The on-colour layered over a container while pressed, under the ripple.
